entries.subject: Placement
entries.finding: Gaia DR3 source 2446440348493043968: position at J2016.0. Distance: Gaia DR3 parallax 9.3912 +/- 0.0214 mas (same row, RUWE 0.93): 106.48 pc, no zero-point correction. Proper motion: Gaia DR3 (same row): -112.585, -8.324 mas/yr. Radial velocity from the same row.

entries.subject: Radius, mass and temperature
entries.finding: Radius 1.147 +/- 0.028 solar radii from Damasso et al. 2025, the stellar radius of the default parameter set of HD 224018 c in the NASA Exoplanet Archive (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2025A&A...702A.118D/abstract). Mass 1.013 +/- 0.069 solar masses from Damasso et al. 2025, the stellar mass of the default parameter set of HD 224018 c in the NASA Exoplanet Archive (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2025A&A...702A.118D/abstract). Temperature 5784 +/- 60 K from Damasso et al. 2025, the stellar temperature of the default parameter set of HD 224018 c in the NASA Exoplanet Archive.

entries.subject: Colour
entries.finding: A Planck spectrum at 5,784 K, because no archive holds a spectrum of this star (stis-ngsl: HD 224018 is not in the library; gaia-xp: Gaia DR3 published no sampled BP/RP spectrum of it; pulkovo: no HR number; kiehling: no HR number; kharitonov: no HR number; burnashev: no HR (BS) number), through the CIE 1931 2-degree observer: #fff1ea. Routes tried in order: stis-ngsl: HD 224018 is not in the library; gaia-xp: Gaia DR3 published no sampled BP/RP spectrum of it; pulkovo: no HR number; kiehling: no HR number; kharitonov: no HR number; burnashev: no HR (BS) number; planck: used.

entries.subject: Limb darkening
entries.finding: The disc is dimmed toward the limb by the quadratic law Claret & Bloemen (2011), A&A 529, A75 compute from ATLAS model atmospheres for the Johnson V band at 5,784 K and log g 4.32 (u1 0.456, u2 0.262): a model, because no fit of this star's limb is used.
